NUMBERED TRANSCRIPT (one sentence per line):
[0] Good morning.
[1] I am Dr.
[2] Norgard.
[3] We have not met before.
[4] Could I have your name, please?
[5] Good morning.
[6] Birta Rees.
[7] Welcome, Birta.
[8] Please have a seat.
[9] What can I help you with today?
[10] I need my prescriptions renewed.
[11] The asthma medicine and the one for stomach acid.
[12] Of course.
[13] Before we do that, has anything new turned up?
[14] Any new symptoms?
[15] No, nothing new.
[16] Should there be?
[17] I do worry about the asthma sometimes.
[18] That is a fair thing to wonder about.
[19] Nothing you have described today points to something new.
[20] It is the allergic kind of asthma I have.
[21] Is that right?
[22] Yes, allergic asthma.
[23] That is the condition we are treating.
[24] I just want to be sure it is not quietly getting worse.
[25] Then let us listen to your chest and your heart, and we will know more about today.
[26] Yes, please do.
[27] Breathe normally for me.
[28] And once more?
[29] Is everything all right?
[30] Your lungs and your heart both sound normal.
[31] Nothing abnormal on listening.
[32] That is a relief to hear.
[33] I would describe this as a stable situation.
[34] You do need to continue the treatment you are on.
[35] So I carry on with everything exactly as before?
[36] Exactly as before.
[37] And I will renew both prescriptions today.
[38] Which ones will that be?
[39] Dimista and esomeprazole for the stomach acid.
[40] Both renewed.
[41] Thank you.
[42] That is what I was hoping for.
[43] Did you notice the first frost this morning?
[44] I did.
[45] The car windows were completely white.
[46] Autumn has made its point rather firmly.
[47] It has.
[48] Right.
[49] So I only need to collect the medicine.
[50] That is all.
[51] Anything else before you go?
[52] No, I think that is everything.
[53] Thank you, doctor.
[54] Take care, Birta.
[55] Goodbye.
